description: This file defines the AWS QLDB client class for interacting with Amazon QLDB services, including method declarations for various operations and their asynchronous counterparts.

classes.name: QLDBClient
classes.description: A client class used to interact with Amazon Quantum Ledger Database (QLDB), extending the base AWS client and providing specific methods for QLDB operations.

methods.name: cancelJournalKinesisStream
methods.description: Cancels the specified JournalKinesis stream.

methods.name: cancelJournalKinesisStreamAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously cancels the specified JournalKinesis stream.

methods.name: createLedger
methods.description: Creates a new ledger.

methods.name: createLedgerAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new ledger.

methods.name: deleteLedger
methods.description: Deletes a ledger.

methods.name: deleteLedgerAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes a ledger.

methods.name: describeJournalKinesisStream
methods.description: Returns information about a journal Kinesis stream.

methods.name: describeJournalKinesisStreamAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously returns information about a journal Kinesis stream.

methods.name: describeJournalS3Export
methods.description: Provides information about a journal S3 export.

methods.name: describeJournalS3ExportAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously provides information about a journal S3 export.

methods.name: describeLedger
methods.description: Returns information about a ledger.

methods.name: describeLedgerAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously returns information about a ledger.

methods.name: exportJournalToS3
methods.description: Exports journal data to Amazon S3.

methods.name: exportJournalToS3Async
methods.description: Asynchronously exports journal data to Amazon S3.

methods.name: getBlock
methods.description: Retrieves a block from a journal stream.

methods.name: getBlockAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a block from a journal stream.

methods.name: getDigest
methods.description: Gets a digest of a journal.

methods.name: getDigestAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously gets a digest of a journal.

methods.name: getRevision
methods.description: Retrieves a revision of a journal.

methods.name: getRevisionAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a revision of a journal.

methods.name: listJournalKinesisStreamsForLedger
methods.description: Lists JournalKinesis streams for a ledger.

methods.name: listJournalKinesisStreamsForLedgerAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists JournalKinesis streams for a ledger.

methods.name: listJournalS3Exports
methods.description: Lists journal S3 exports.

methods.name: listJournalS3ExportsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists journal S3 exports.

methods.name: listJournalS3ExportsForLedger
methods.description: Lists journal S3 exports for a ledger.

methods.name: listJournalS3ExportsForLedgerAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists journal S3 exports for a ledger.

methods.name: listLedgers
methods.description: Lists ledgers.

methods.name: listLedgersAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists ledgers.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Lists tags for a resource.

methods.name: listTagsForResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists tags for a resource.

methods.name: streamJournalToKinesis
methods.description: Streams journal data to Kinesis.

methods.name: streamJournalToKinesisAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously streams journal data to Kinesis.

methods.name: tagResource
methods.description: Tags a resource.

methods.name: tagResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously tags a resource.

methods.name: untagResource
methods.description: Removes tags from a resource.

methods.name: untagResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously removes tags from a resource.

methods.name: updateLedger
methods.description: Updates a ledger.

methods.name: updateLedgerAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously updates a ledger.

methods.name: updateLedgerPermissionsMode
methods.description: Updates permissions mode for a ledger.

methods.name: updateLedgerPermissionsModeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously updates permissions mode for a ledger.
